api.creation: Omit voice to preserve the previous nine creative presets, including their effects.
api.velocity: Optional plan note.velocity is MIDI integer 1..127; omission defaults to 96 for demonstration voices.
api.failure: SAMPLE_LOAD_FAILED rejects fetch, body, invalid PCM, decode or 15s timeout. No synthetic fallback is used. An explicit later clean-synth selection is allowed.
api.cancellation: stop(), dispose() or a subsequent play invalidates fetch/decode by generation. Pending play resolves {started:false,cancelled:true}; late work cannot start voices or publish cache.
api.reference: reference(hz) always synthesizes an exact-frequency sine and routes it directly to the output volume bus, bypassing creative preset filters, compression, reverb and delay.
api.status: Adds demoVoice, sampleBuffers and sampleLoading to existing status fields.

resources.loading: No construction/first-screen request. Each explicit sampled plan loads only the nearest required source notes, serially; validated decoded buffers are cached for that audio context and cleared on dispose.
resources.conversion: Reproducible Python standard-library script: stereo-to-mono average, 63-tap anti-alias filter and 2:1 downsampling to PCM16 22050Hz, 2.8s with attack retained, 40ms sustain crossfade, attack/tail fades, peak 0.8.
resources.license: CC0-1.0; seven selected VSCO-2-CE arco vibrato notes only, pinned to commit 440300901dfe9275fd84e0b7763af1f8443ae62e.
resources.credits: Sam Gossner & Simon Dalzell; sample cutting Elan Hickler/Soundemote. Source/transformed SHA256 and license SHA256 are included in the packaged manifest.

coverage: No automatic audio, microphone or sample fetch
All nine creative presets and original microphone/loop workflows retained
Independent unfiltered reference and clean voices
Stop while ready/fetch/body/decode, dispose, rapid voice replacement
AbortSignal, retry after failure, 64-voice bound and partial-start cleanup
verification.independentChecks: 9/9 checks, 7/7 assets; source and derived hashes match, exact license bytes match, non-empty PCM without clipping, loop seam step below natural adjacent-sample P99, approximate fundamental errors -4.2 to +8.11 cents.
verification.syntaxAndWhitespace: node --check and git diff --check passed for owned source changes.

integrationByRoot: Explicitly pass prefs.demoVoice in Library/Practice/MIDI/Scale playback
Expose four-language explanation and user-selected clean fallback
Include seven WAVs, manifest and license in release/offline whitelists and source backup
Rename Acoustic display label to basic synthesis while preserving stored preset key
Perform browser visual/audio QA and available real-device listening
limits: Single-velocity, seven-note vibrato samples with pitch shifting do not demonstrate real bowing, articulation or teacher performance
G3 uses A3 shifted downward by two semitones
Digital data and mock WebAudio QA do not prove physical device latency, speaker quality or professional sound
No Apple assets, hardware protocol, microphone input replacement, shared client/build/HTML or service-worker edits were made by this agent
